explanation: An Egyptian slave woman who was the servant of Sarah, Abraham's wife.
Abraham's wife, who could not have children and therefore gave Hagar to Abraham to bear a descendant.
The patriarch of the Jewish people, who made a covenant with God and received the promise of numerous descendants.
The condition in which a woman carries an unborn child in her womb.
A feeling of strong disapproval or disgust toward someone or something.
A dry, inhospitable landscape with little vegetation and rainfall, where Hagar fled.
A divine messenger who conveys God's will and protection.
Son of Abraham and Hagar, and the ancestor of the Ishmaelites, an Arab people.
To give divine favor, protection, or prosperity to someone or something.
The ability to produce many offspring, often used as a metaphor for abundance and growth.
